blocks.x: EUDR due-diligence automated — compliance evidence in hours, premium channels opened
A global coffee trader — Agriculture & Food Systems engagement delivered by a 14-person team over 12 months, Global (Origin: SA/Africa) scope, commercial model: build + managed network.

items: EUDR geolocation evidence assembled manually per lot; customs risk.
Provenance claims unverifiable; premium buyers skeptical.
Custody events paper-based across origin chain.

blocks.x: The chain-of-custody network anchors plot geolocation and custody events from farm to port with verifiable credentials for participants; regulator and buyer verification interfaces serve scoped evidence; and the traceability spine answers due-diligence queries in hours with cryptographic provenance.

The cadence, without the ceremony: weeks 1–2 lock the baseline with your team: the metric, its measurement method and its owner, all signed before a line of build code ships. the pilot block (weeks 3–8) ships one complete path end to end, on real traffic, with rollback rehearsed — bounded scope is a feature, not a limitation. the closing block hardens the capability: runbooks handed to your operators, alerting wired to your channels, and the delta versus baseline reported with method notes attached. Each gate can end the program, redirect it, or release the next slice — decided on the signed numbers, recorded in the ledger, no exceptions.

items: The delta we sign up to is 10x — verified against live data at every gate
Target range down 58 on the first working slice, with the method note attached

blocks.x: Towers: Blockchain & Digital Trust, IoT, Digital Twin & Robotics, Data, Analytics & Lakehouse. Platforms: Patient Priority Portal, BI & Analytics Platform, Fleet Management System.

items: What moved unchanged between sectors, and why it was safe to move — stated plainly.
Runs on the Achala Method cadence — baseline signed before build, delta reviewed at every gate

blocks.x: Identity withheld under confidentiality — the client approved the numbers, not the name. Every metric traces to the week-two baseline; the method pack is shared under NDA on request.
Ask for the reference call with a client running this pattern, or scope your own version in a two-week value assessment.
